judge.oldCause: post-deploy verify failed because the freshly deployed Worker was cold and its first request exceeded the verify request timeout (fix: a longer timeout and retries).
judge.newCause: no request was slow (about 40 ms each, with a 30 s timeout in place); verify began one second after the deploy command returned and was answered by the PREVIOUS version, which kept serving the route for another 38 s (/__version reported the old commit). The cause is that verify ran before the new deploy was live, an artifact-identity failure, so a longer timeout does nothing.
